authentication.finding: The official CLI returned slow_down before saving credentials and does not persist its device grant. The displayed user code cannot recover that terminated grant.
authentication.workaround: Ignored local helper persists its own device grant and honors polling interval and slow_down backoff; simulated checks passed. No new grant created during preflight.
